Federal Signal Hook Brackets

Federal Signal hook brackets provide the vehicle-roof mounting interface for hook-on lightbars across the Navigator, Allegiant Max, Vision SLR, and compatible bar families. Why installers choose Federal Signal Hook Brackets

  • Vehicle-specific profiles → hook brackets are engineered to match the roof contour of common patrol vehicles and apparatus, ensuring full contact and secure mounting without shimming or modification
  • Standard and low-hook configurations → low-hook brackets reduce installed bar height on vehicles where aerodynamic profile and reduced wind noise are priorities
  • Rated for lightbar load → brackets engineered to handle the weight and dynamic load of full-size lightbars at highway speeds and over rough terrain
  • Corrosion-resistant finish → protected against rust and degradation from weather, wash-downs, and temperature cycling

  • Full lighting suite built in → front flood, rear flood, left flood, right flood, takedowns, alley lights, work lights, and OBDII-integrated stop/tail/turn all available in one unit

  • IP69K rated (select SKUs) → highest ingress protection rating available, withstanding high-pressure wash-down — critical for vehicles operating in harsh field conditions

  • The Valor® is Federal Signal's most distinctive low-profile lightbar — and the only bar in the lineup built around a V-shape non-linear design that physically changes how light reaches the road. At under 2 inches tall, it sits nearly flush with the roofline while delivering 360-degree output and superior intersection-angle warning that flat linear bars at the same height cannot match. Available in law enforcement, fire/EMS, and work truck configurations across 44" and 51" lengths, the Valor covers more applications in a single product family than any other bar Federal Signal makes at this profile height.

For departments and fleets that want maximum performance, a distinctive appearance, and full tactical lighting capability in the lowest-profile package available — this is the bar.

Why departments and fleets choose the Valor

  • V-shape non-linear design → delivers true 360-degree output and superior off-axis warning at critical intersection angles that linear bars at the same height cannot physically replicate — the shape itself is a core performance feature, not just aesthetics
  • Under 2" tall → one of the lowest-profile full-featured lightbars on the market, delivering full warning output while maintaining the clean roofline look that unmarked, semi-marked, and aesthetics-conscious fleets demand
  • SpectraLux® tri-color per module → up to three colors per module covering Amber, Blue, Green, Red, and White — a single bar handles law enforcement warning, fire/EMS compliance, work zone visibility, and scene flood lighting without additional hardware
  • Solaris® LED reflector technology → maximizes LED output, eliminates dark spots, and increases off-axis visibility across both the 44" and 51" configurations
  • ROC (Reliable Onboard Circuitry™) → eliminates approximately 85% of the connection failure points found in a typical lightbar by replacing wires, connectors, and assemblies with PCB assemblies — the single most important durability advantage on high-rotation patrol and work truck fleets
  • Integrated Vortex™ generators → reduce aerodynamic drag and wind noise at highway speeds — a meaningful advantage on high-mileage patrol and utility vehicles where these factors accumulate across thousands of annual miles
  • Full lighting suite → left-flood, right-flood, full-flood, takedowns, alley lights, work lights, and stop/tail/turn all available regardless of color configuration
  • HotFoot® mounting available → optional system for additional LED alley and takedown lights, expanding scene lighting without a separate bar or bracket
  • SignalMaster® directional warning → integrated traffic direction without a separate mount or controller, available across all configurations
  • FS Convergence Network → plug-and-play RJ45 installation with FSJoin and Pathfinder® controller compatibility for synchronized multi-device programming across the entire vehicle
  • Optional quick-disconnect → easy service removal from the vehicle without tools, simplifying maintenance on high-volume fleet rotations

Valor vs. Integrity — which bar is right for your fleet?

Both are low-profile, under 2" tall, and available in 44" and 51" lengths. The Valor's V-shape delivers superior 360-degree and intersection-angle output through its non-linear design and is wider (19.8" vs 9.7"). The Integrity is narrower, has one more flash pattern (28 vs 27), adds OBDII-integrated S/T/T, and offers more controller expansion options. For departments prioritizing roofline geometry and intersection warning: Valor. For departments prioritizing function count, controller integration, and a narrower footprint: Integrity.

Federal Signal Valor® — Low-Profile Non-Linear LED Lightbar (44" & 51")

  • The Valor® is Federal Signal's most distinctive low-profile lightbar — and the only bar in the lineup built around a V-shape non-linear design that physically changes how light reaches the road. At under 2 inches tall, it sits nearly flush with the roofline while delivering 360-degree output and superior intersection-angle warning that flat linear bars at the same height cannot match. Available in law enforcement, fire/EMS, and work truck configurations across 44" and 51" lengths, the Valor covers more applications in a single product family than any other bar Federal Signal makes at this profile height.

For departments and fleets that want maximum performance, a distinctive appearance, and full tactical lighting capability in the lowest-profile package available — this is the bar.

Why departments and fleets choose the Valor

  • V-shape non-linear design → delivers true 360-degree output and superior off-axis warning at critical intersection angles that linear bars at the same height cannot physically replicate — the shape itself is a core performance feature, not just aesthetics
  • Under 2" tall → one of the lowest-profile full-featured lightbars on the market, delivering full warning output while maintaining the clean roofline look that unmarked, semi-marked, and aesthetics-conscious fleets demand
  • SpectraLux® tri-color per module → up to three colors per module covering Amber, Blue, Green, Red, and White — a single bar handles law enforcement warning, fire/EMS compliance, work zone visibility, and scene flood lighting without additional hardware
  • Solaris® LED reflector technology → maximizes LED output, eliminates dark spots, and increases off-axis visibility across both the 44" and 51" configurations
  • ROC (Reliable Onboard Circuitry™) → eliminates approximately 85% of the connection failure points found in a typical lightbar by replacing wires, connectors, and assemblies with PCB assemblies — the single most important durability advantage on high-rotation patrol and work truck fleets
  • Integrated Vortex™ generators → reduce aerodynamic drag and wind noise at highway speeds — a meaningful advantage on high-mileage patrol and utility vehicles where these factors accumulate across thousands of annual miles
  • Full lighting suite → left-flood, right-flood, full-flood, takedowns, alley lights, work lights, and stop/tail/turn all available regardless of color configuration
  • HotFoot® mounting available → optional system for additional LED alley and takedown lights, expanding scene lighting without a separate bar or bracket
  • SignalMaster® directional warning → integrated traffic direction without a separate mount or controller, available across all configurations
  • FS Convergence Network → plug-and-play RJ45 installation with FSJoin and Pathfinder® controller compatibility for synchronized multi-device programming across the entire vehicle
  • Optional quick-disconnect → easy service removal from the vehicle without tools, simplifying maintenance on high-volume fleet rotations
  • Rooftop-serviceable → can be serviced without removal from the vehicle roof
  • Low-power mode → protects vehicle battery and alternator during extended stationary operation

Federal Signal Integrity® — Low-Profile Linear LED Lightbar (51")

  • The Integrity® is Federal Signal's most feature-complete low-profile linear lightbar — packing 28 flash patterns, built-in SignalMaster® directional warning, full flood capability, OBDII-integrated stop/tail/turn, and SpectraLux® multicolor technology into a bar that sits just under 2 inches above the roofline. For departments that want the clean, low-profile look of a linear bar without sacrificing a single operational capability, the Integrity is the answer.

Where the Valor earns its performance through its V-shape geometry, the Integrity earns it through sheer feature density — more functions, more flash patterns, and more integration options than any other linear bar in the Federal Signal lineup at this profile height.

Why departments choose the Integrity

  • 28 flash patterns with full lighting suite including front flood, rear flood, left flood, right flood, takedowns, alley lights, OBDII-integrated stop/tail/turn, and work lights — the most comprehensive integrated function set of any low-profile linear bar in the Federal Signal lineup
  • SpectraLux® multicolor per module → changes color through user-selected flash patterns between Amber, Blue, Green, Red, and White — in all-white mode provides an impressive flood light to quickly illuminate an emergency scene
  • Single-, dual-, and tri-color capability → one bar covers standard patrol warning, fire/EMS compliance, traffic direction, and scene flood lighting without additional hardware or separate controllers
  • Built-in SignalMaster® directional warning → integrated traffic direction arrow-stick without a separate mount, controller, or wiring run
  • Solaris® LED reflector technology → maximizes LED output, eliminates dark spots, and increases off-axis visibility across the full bar length
  • ROC (Reliable Onboard Circuitry™) → eliminates approximately 85% of connection failure points by replacing wires, connectors, and assemblies with PCB assemblies — the most reliability-focused construction in the Federal Signal low-profile lineup
  • HotFoot® mounting available → optional system for additional LED alley, takedown, and warning lights, expanding scene lighting without a separate bar
  • Easy rooftop service → can be serviced while installed on the rooftop without removing the bar from the vehicle
  • FS Convergence Network → plug-and-play RJ45 installation compatible with Four-, Six-, and Nine-Button serial controllers plus Relay Module for up to four auxiliary lighting devices from a single controller
  • OBDII-integrated stop/tail/turn → reduces wiring complexity on patrol vehicle builds
  • Low-power mode → protects vehicle battery and alternator during extended stationary operation

Integrity vs. Valor — which bar is right for your fleet?

Both are low-profile, under 2" tall, and available in 44" and 51" lengths. The Valor's V-shape delivers superior 360-degree and intersection-angle output through its non-linear design and is wider (19.8" vs 9.7"). The Integrity is narrower, has one more flash pattern (28 vs 27), adds OBDII-integrated S/T/T, and offers more controller expansion options. For departments prioritizing roofline geometry and intersection warning: Valor. For departments prioritizing function count, controller integration, and a narrower footprint: Integrity.
